binary_provenance.scope: Candidate changes Turin kernel challenger ordering; identical kernel sources.

resource_validation.scope: Original fixture remains FAILED. All productive windows unchanged; same candidate passed a separately bound, fully repeated resource fixture with measurable reclaim pressure.

rationale: All four cold pairs improved; the lower descriptive paired 95% bound is positive. Four cached pairs remain within the predefined -2% non-regression bound. Fixed streaming build controls are effectively unchanged; no build-effect correction applied.

All eight cold legs started at 32 workers and logged two successful A/B/A confirmation cycles. Conservative bounds on rounded log rates pass both cycles with the existing gain, drift and quantization margins. All eight cached legs restored their own count and logged confirmed streaming restoration.

Only AuthenticAMD family 1Ah/model 02h challenger order changes. The existing initial kernel, runtime ISA support, two confirmations, AVX2 comparison, count/backing cache identity and resource safeguards remain. Ordering is part of the cache fingerprint.

21 full-size reference transitions passed. Original productive observations have no swap/OOM or quarantine. The original resource fixture failed because it caused no actual reclaim; its failure is preserved. The separate complete resource test used the identical candidate and verified reclaim, parking, recovery, constrained restart and explicit opt-out.
Supplement cache retained 3 workers. Recovery after constrained restart reached 2 workers with at least 4 GiB anonymous backing within the observed 210 seconds; return to all 3 was not demonstrated.
limitations: Four pairs on one bare-metal host, descriptive intervals only. Productive log-derived lower bounds include startup/tuning/shutdown and omit final unlogged hashes; they are not steady-state throughput.
Power was not measured during the automatic runs; the 280 W setting is a cap, not measured package watts.

First-confirmation snapshots have 10-second resolution. Logs retain rounded rates; the winner cache retains the later losing challenger comparison rather than all earlier raw promotion samples. Conservative rounded-rate review plus frozen code and unit gates support this decision, not an exact raw replay.
Balanced tuning selected 47-48 workers; no claim of full search convergence or optimal steady-state worker count.
The bounded reclaim helper was supervisor-killed after its pressure phase (exit -9); OOM counters stayed zero. This is preserved as bounded fixture cleanup, not a normal helper exit.
Benchmark identities are frozen measured revisions; integration rebases do not imply later binaries were benchmarked.
